description: Sagada, Philippines (Fafnir-ID format): the hanging coffins of Echo Valley — for some 2,000 years the Kankanaey Igorot have hung their honoured elders' coffins on limestone cliffs, the higher the closer to the sky; the last traditional hanging was in 2010. Full episode composition (Remotion + three.js), rendered in chunks on GitHub Actions.
name: fafnir-sagada-peti-gantung
